attachments.name: Rangefinder Optic
attachments.desc: The Grimhawk's boxy rangefinder: a red dot in a short tube. Slightly tighter zoom.

attachments.name: P.T. Expanse Mag
attachments.desc: A fan-shaped flechette drum: 35 rounds, a little slower to reload.

attachments.name: Reflex Sight
attachments.desc: A glowing dot sight. Slightly tighter zoom.

attachments.name: Extended Mag
attachments.desc: +50% magazine size.

attachments.name: Suppressor
attachments.desc: Much quieter shots. Kills are a little more likely to drop a power-up. −15% damage and range.

attachments.name: Red Dot Sight
attachments.desc: A compact red dot. Tighter zoom than the reflex.

attachments.name: Grip
attachments.desc: Hip fire spreads 45% less.

attachments.name: Drum Mag
attachments.desc: Double magazine size, slower reload.

attachments.name: Dual Mag
attachments.desc: Taped mags: reloads 30% faster.

attachments.name: ACOG Scope
attachments.desc: 4× scope with an illuminated chevron. +25% headshot damage.

attachments.name: Grenade Launcher
attachments.desc: Underbarrel 40mm launcher. Press 5 to switch to it.

attachments.name: Masterkey
attachments.desc: Underbarrel shotgun. Press 5 to switch to it.

attachments.name: Flamethrower
attachments.desc: Underbarrel flamethrower: sets zombies alight at short range. Press 5 to switch to it.

attachments.name: IR Scope
attachments.desc: Thermal scope: zombies glow white through it.

attachments.name: Variable Zoom
attachments.desc: Swaps the stock scope for a variable zoom: mouse wheel steps 4×–10× while scoped.

attachments.name: Holographic Sight
attachments.desc: A wide holographic window with a glowing reticle. Slightly tighter zoom.

attachments.name: 2× Reflex
attachments.desc: A reflex sight with a 2× lens: noticeably tighter zoom.

attachments.name: Laser Sight
attachments.desc: Tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Hawkeye 3× Scope
attachments.desc: A long-eye scope for picking out targets for the flechettes. +20% headshot damage.

attachments.name: Long Barrel
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige barrel: rounds home from the hip instead of when aiming. +25% range.

attachments.name: Hollow Points
attachments.desc: More damage up close, less range.

attachments.name: Long Barrel
attachments.desc: Reaches further and hits a little harder.

attachments.name: Rubber Grip
attachments.desc: Tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Tactical Stock
attachments.desc: Steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: FMJ Rounds
attachments.desc: Longer range and a little more headshot damage.

attachments.name: Quickdraw Grip
attachments.desc: Faster reloads.

attachments.name: Rapid Fire
attachments.desc: Fires 15% faster, each shot a little weaker.

attachments.name: Short Barrel
attachments.desc: Better hip fire, less range.

attachments.name: Light Stock
attachments.desc: Quicker handling and reloads.

attachments.name: Hot Loads
attachments.desc: Every shot hits a little harder.

attachments.name: Tuning Fork Reflex
attachments.desc: Two prongs ringing either side of a lilac dot. Steadier aim and a slightly tighter view.

attachments.name: MFS Deflection Core
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige magazine. Orbs ricochet off walls and leap from zombie to zombie instead of passing through, and fly 50% faster (about 48 m of travel). 9 rounds, slower to fire.

attachments.name: Overclock Cell
attachments.desc: A hot, finned cell that reaches full charge in half the time. Only 4 rounds.

attachments.name: Resonance Chamber
attachments.desc: Charging makes the orb bigger instead of faster: a full charge is nearly four times as wide, at walking pace, and clears a corridor.

attachments.name: Hush Baffle
attachments.desc: A fluted baffle that muffles the wail and the shot. Kills are a little more likely to drop a power-up.

attachments.name: Echo Rounds
attachments.desc: A fully charged shot leaves an echo: a ghost orb follows the same path 0.4 s later, at half damage, for no ammo.

attachments.name: Lancet Tear Grip
attachments.desc: BO7's raked grip: charges 15% faster and holds the charge while you sprint.

attachments.name: Soma-81 Grip
attachments.desc: A chunky rubber grip: 6% faster movement with the Siren in hand.

attachments.name: Ballistic Computer
attachments.desc: A green rangefinder screen on the rail. Draws the round's arc as you aim and rings where it will land.

attachments.name: Proximity Fuse
attachments.desc: Six seeker eyes on the muzzle. Stuck rounds arm after half a second and go off by themselves when a zombie walks up: the Havoc lays mines.

attachments.name: Kinetic Rail
attachments.desc: Copper coils round the barrel. Rounds fly much faster and flatter, and a round that sticks to a zombie hits it hard on the way in.

attachments.name: Napalm Rounds
attachments.desc: Each blast leaves a burning pool for 5 seconds that keeps hurting anything standing in it.

attachments.name: Redwell Dash
attachments.desc: BO7's skeleton grip. 7% faster on your feet with the Havoc in hand.

attachments.name: Extended Tube
attachments.desc: A longer magazine tube under the barrel. 8 rounds, slower to reload.

attachments.name: Cryo Rounds
attachments.desc: Blasts freeze: zombies caught in (or near) one slow to 40% for 4 seconds, and a zombie that dies frozen shatters. Slightly less damage.

attachments.name: Tripwire Spool
attachments.desc: Strings a laser wire from each stuck round to the one you fired before it (up to about 16 m, in line of sight). A zombie crossing a wire sets off both ends.

attachments.name: Mortar Sleeve
attachments.desc: Finned sleeve and an elevation quadrant. Rounds are lobbed high over cover; blasts are 35% wider and 20% harder.

attachments.name: Arc Rounds
attachments.desc: Each blast throws lightning on to up to five more zombies outside it, each link at 45% damage.

attachments.name: Bandolier
attachments.desc: Four spare rounds strapped to the stock. 50% more reserve ammo.

attachments.name: Daisy Chain
attachments.desc: Detonation sequencer. Your rounds go off one after another in the order you fired them, 0.12 s apart, each 15% bigger than the last.

attachments.name: Actuator
attachments.desc: BO7's hydraulic rear grip: a ram racks the pump for you. Fires 40% faster and reloads 15% faster.

attachments.name: Cluster Rounds
attachments.desc: Each blast scatters five bomblets that bounce and go off a moment later.

attachments.name: Breacher Stock
attachments.desc: Shock-absorbing stock. Your own blasts never hurt you; standing close to one throws you into the air instead (Havoc jumps).

attachments.name: Singularity Rounds
attachments.desc: A detonation first pulls zombies within about 10 m in for most of a second, then blows at 150% damage and 15% wider.

attachments.name: MFS Airstrike Mag
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige magazine. Rounds don't stick: they fly 40% faster, bounce off walls and airburst as they pass a zombie (or after 1.2 s). No detonator needed.

attachments.name: Gunner's Scope
attachments.desc: An armoured 4× box sight on the rail, like a vehicle gun's. +25% headshot damage.

attachments.name: Breach Reflex
attachments.desc: An open red dot on a tall mount. Aimed shots kick half as much.

attachments.name: Concussion Brake
attachments.desc: A flared, finned bell. The muzzle blast shoves zombies in front of you back several metres and staggers them for a second.

attachments.name: Thump Baffle
attachments.desc: A fat suppressor can: the crack becomes a thump. Less kick; with HE or Flak shells the blast is a little tighter but 15% harder.

attachments.name: Tungsten Rail Barrel
attachments.desc: Copper rails along the barrel. 50% more range, and the shell punches through one more zombie.

attachments.name: MFS Warhead Autoloader
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige magazine: a drum autoloader. Full auto, 15 rounds and a faster cycle, but a wider spread from the hip.

attachments.name: Damper Grip
attachments.desc: A rubber grip on a damped spring. 40% less kick and steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Snap Grip
attachments.desc: A slim skeleton grip with a mag-release paddle. 20% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Hydraulic Buffer Stock
attachments.desc: Twin hydraulic cylinders in the stock soak 60% of the kick. Steadier from the hip.

attachments.name: Kick Stock
attachments.desc: A bare strut with a stiff spring and no buffer. Every shot shoves you back along your aim; fire at your feet to cannon-jump.

attachments.name: Bipod
attachments.desc: Folding legs under the barrel. Braced (crouched, prone or standing still): +40% damage, no kick, and a 15% bigger blast with HE or Flak shells.

attachments.name: HE Shells
attachments.desc: High-explosive shells: each bursts on what it hits (or in the air at the end of its range) in a small blast, trading 40% of the direct hit for it. Close blasts hurt you too, unless you have PhD Flopper.

attachments.name: Sabot Darts
attachments.desc: Tungsten darts instead of shells: each one goes through every zombie in line for 150% damage.

attachments.name: Thermite Shells
attachments.desc: Incendiary rounds: the ground where each one strikes burns for four seconds.

attachments.name: Flak Fuse
attachments.desc: Explosive shells with a proximity fuse: each airbursts beside the first zombie it passes, throwing shrapnel on ahead along its line, or bursts on what it hits.

attachments.name: Shock Shells
attachments.desc: Lightning arcs from where each round strikes to up to four more zombies.

attachments.name: Canister Shot
attachments.desc: A can of flechettes: the ROC becomes a shotgun. Ten pellets.

attachments.name: Tracer Mark
attachments.desc: Every zombie the round hits glows orange for eight seconds and takes 50% more damage from everything.

attachments.name: RL-7.62 Compensator
attachments.desc: A ported compensator. 25% less kick per shot.

attachments.name: R-556 Chief Barrel
attachments.desc: A heavy fluted barrel. 25% more range and a little more damage at distance.

attachments.name: VAS Foregrip
attachments.desc: A stubby vertical grip. 25% less kick, tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Wessi Fast Belt
attachments.desc: A short 50-round belt in a slim pouch: 30% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Kepler Reflex
attachments.desc: An open reflex sight with a red dot.

attachments.name: Lucius-90 Grip
attachments.desc: A textured rear grip. Steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Monolithic Suppressor
attachments.desc: Suppressed. Slightly shorter range, 10% less kick.

attachments.name: Fractal-LRB Barrel
attachments.desc: A long ribbed barrel. 40% more range, 15% less kick.

attachments.name: Enforcer Extended Belt
attachments.desc: An 85-round belt in a big pouch. Slower to reload.

attachments.name: Overpressured Rounds
attachments.desc: Hotter loads: 15% more damage and 10% more range.

attachments.name: Aegis-X40 Stock
attachments.desc: A padded heavy stock. 40% less kick, steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Cryo Shroud
attachments.desc: Custom: a liquid-cooled barrel shroud. The barrel heats 35% slower and every hit chills the zombie (slower for 2 s; a long burst freezes it nearly still).

attachments.name: Accelerated Recoil System
attachments.desc: A lighter bolt: 20% faster fire, 20% more kick, and the barrel heats faster.

attachments.name: MFS Motion Strike Laser
attachments.desc: A side laser. 30% tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Thermal Feedback
attachments.desc: Custom: the hotter the barrel, the harder each round hits, up to +50% damage just short of overheating. Sustained fire builds heat on any belt.

attachments.name: Leyden Spark Belt Fed
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige belt: 300 rounds fed straight from your reserve, so it never reloads, but about 55 rounds of sustained fire overheat it (a 1.9 s lockout). Custom: when it overheats the stored charge leaps from the gun as lightning that chains through up to six nearby zombies.

attachments.name: Titan Wield
attachments.desc: BO7's Season 2 conversion: a second XM325 in your left hand. Hip fire only, each gun runs its own 500-round belt (1,000 in the counter) fed from your reserve with no reloads and fires 25% slower for 40% less damage per round (together, 50% faster than one gun). Each gun overheats after about 50 rounds of sustained fire. No underbarrel or magazine attachments.

_ironSightsNote: Iron sights (front and rear) removed when an optic is fitted, so the front post doesn't show through the sight window. On the M16/Commando the bone is the carry handle with the front post; on the FAMAS it's the handle. 2026-10-15: the BO3 imports whose stock sight is its own bone: SMG5, 93R tag_ironsight; RPD, MG4 tag_frontsight_up; MR23 j_rearsight (the 93R's tag_handle is its fold-down grip). MP7, AA12 and P90 sights are part of the receiver mesh (no bone), so they stay.
_levelsNote: levels: every gun with a Gunsmith has this many levels; its attachments are spread over them (first at level 2, last at levels-2) and the levels between are filler (no unlock: progression and prestige). padTo: guns with fewer attachments than this get stat-only generic ones (generic: true, no model) in the barrel / stock / grip / ammo slots, in catalogue order, until they have padTo. curve: XP to the next level = base * level^exponent.
